item.title: Albany rally demands transparency in CDPAP home care program
item.description: Home care workers, consumers and advocates rallied in Albany on Thursday for more transparency and oversight of the state's CDPAP home care program. The group, New York Caring Majority, claims the transition to Public Partnerships Limited has caused significant disruptions, with over 150,000 workers and 90,000 consumers leaving the program. The post Albany rally demands transparency in CDPAP home care program appeared first on WNYT.com NewsChannel 13.
